title: Yoruba
motto: A tonal, poetic language of royal traditions, respect, and ancient wisdom.
description: Discover one of Africa's most influential languages, renowned for its melodic tones, respect systems (ọ̀wọ̀), and rich philosophical proverbs.

proverbOfDay.proverb: Ilé l’à ń wò k’á tó sọmọ l’órúkọ.
proverbOfDay.translation: One must consider family lineage, circumstances and character before giving a child a name.
proverbOfDay.context: Yoruba names always have deep spiritual and contextual meanings that tell a story of the family's journey.

slangs.meaning: Is everything good with you? (Warm, standard check-in)
slangs.example: Ẹ kú àárọ̀, ṣe dáadáa ni gbogbo nǹkan?

slangs.meaning: You nailed it! / You are unbeatable! (Expression of praise)
slangs.example: Bí o ṣe kọrin yẹn, o jẹ́ gbà púpọ̀!

slangs.meaning: There is no trouble / No problem whatsoever.
slangs.example: Kò sí wàhálà rárá, màá wá lọ́la.
Mo dúpẹ́ púpọ̀ fún oúnjẹ dídùn yìí.

cultureTips.title: The Honorific 'Ẹ' vs Casual 'O'
cultureTips.description: In Yoruba culture, respect (Ọ̀wọ̀) is supreme. When speaking to an elder, prefix with 'Ẹ' (plural/honorific), e.g. 'Ẹ kú àárọ̀' rather than 'O kú àárọ̀'.

cultureTips.title: The Tones: Do - Re - Mi
cultureTips.description: Yoruba is a tonal language with three musical pitches: Low (À), Mid (A), and High (Á).

customFlashcards.back: How are you? / How are things?

customFlashcards.example: Ẹ ṣeé púpọ̀ fún ìrànwọ́ yín.
O dábọ̀, títí di ìgbà mìíràn.

customUnits.title: Unit 1: The Yoruba Alphabet and Vowel System (Álífábẹ́ẹ̀tì àti Fáwẹ́lì)
customUnits.subtitle: The 25 letters of Álífábẹ́ẹ̀tì Yorùbá, oral vs. nasal vowels, sub-dots (ẹ, ọ, ṣ), and the three tones (Dó, Re, Mì).

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Álífábẹ́ẹ̀tì, Fáwẹ́lì àti Àmì Ohùn (Alphabet, Vowels & Tonal System)
lessons.description: Master the 25 letters of standard Yoruba, sub-dotted vowels and consonants (ẹ, ọ, ṣ), nasal vowels, and tone identification.

questions.prompt: How many letters are in the standard Yoruba alphabet (Álífábẹ́ẹ̀tì Yorùbá)?
questions.explanation: The standard Yoruba alphabet has 25 letters: 7 oral vowels and 18 consonants (letters c, q, v, x, z are not included).

questions.prompt: Match the sub-dotted Yoruba letters with their phonetic descriptions:
The three fundamental tones in Yoruba are High (Dó), Mid (Re), and Low (___).
questions.sentence: The three fundamental tones in Yoruba are High (Dó), Mid (Re), and Low (___).
questions.explanation: Yoruba has 3 musical register tones: Dó (High tone /), Re (Mid tone - unmarked), and Mì (Low tone \).
